newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mostly weaker in the after-hours session on profit-taking ahead of the long weekend, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.6 yen per kg lower to flat from the day's close, with benchmark May down 0.2 yen at 146.3 yen.
The spot December contract expired at noon, down 0.2 yen at 139.8 yen, with 747 lots of deliveries.

"The sharply lower expiry price in Tokyo fuelled some fresh selling in nearby months here, but further falls could be limited by expected technical buying," one Kobe trader said. The market will be closed Monday for a national holiday.
